verdicts.rationale: The standard requires students to share relevant and accurate information through a variety of different modes (C). The relevance and accuracy clauses are met by these student-performed oral contributions grounded in the text, poem, and video. However, the "variety of different modes" clause is only partially met: the dominant student mode is oral sharing (partner talk, whole-group responses), while the written component is teacher-scribed shared writing where the teacher completes the recording form using student ideas — the students do not independently produce written text as a second mode. A future lesson where students write in their own Sky notebooks would likely strengthen this clause.

The lesson builds toward independent Sky notebook writing in the next lesson but does not reach it here.
